budget_items.topic: Fire department FY25 level service budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The proposed FY25 level service budget is a 2.21% overall increase, including contractual increases and 100% paramedics coverage.
budget_items.quote: the proposed level service budget for 2025 consists of an overall 2.21% increase from last year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Replacement public safety radios cost between $3,000 and $5,000 per unit with a 10-25 year lifespan; radio maintenance rises by $10,000; a replacement grant was applied for and denied.
budget_items.quote: replacement of public safety grade radios that range from $3,000 to $5,000 per unit and have a lifespan of 10-25 years.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Radio maintenance increases by a stated amount.
budget_items.quote: there is a $10,000 increase in radio maintenance.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A state grant for firefighting equipment funded 3 portable radios and power saws.
budget_items.quote: a state grant for firefighting equipment was received in fy 24 and $18,853 was used to cover 3 portable radios and the replacement of power saws.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The EMPG grant totaled an amount used for cold water rescue suits and an inflatable rescue sled.
budget_items.quote: in fy 24, the empg grant was awarded and totaled $3,750.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A S.A.F.E. / Senior Safe grant totaled an amount used for smoke detectors, senior safety and fire safety education.
budget_items.quote: a grant for s.a.f.e. / senior safe was received and totaled $7,430.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Road maintenance bids came in under estimate and the contract was awarded to PJ Keating for a 1-year term.
budget_items.quote: the bid was $127,000 under the estimate. this bid was awarded to pj keating for a 1-year contract totaling $634,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: New growth and certification were approved at a stated figure.
budget_items.quote: the new growth and certification were approved at $630,220.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The $120,000 overlay will not change per a Board of Assessors vote; additional new growth goes to the school budget.
budget_items.quote: the additional new growth of $236,025.50 will be added to the school's budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported the Chapter 90 account holds a stated balance; funds were not used while old pavement plan roads were completed.
budget_items.quote: heather lemieux states there is 1.9 million in that account.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Parks Commission was granted a $1 million grant, bringing secured grant money to a stated total.
budget_items.quote: chris menard states the parks commission was granted a 1-million-dollar grant bringing their secured grant money amount up to 2.5 million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A new $25,000 budget line for high school department heads, previously covered by a revolving account, is now contractual.
budget_items.quote: tom gray questions why there was a $25,000-budget line for high school department heads

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Line 2110 rose from FY24 to FY25 due to a curriculum director position being funded more fully in the local budget; the school said this does not reflect raises.
budget_items.quote: in fy 24 it was $234,000 and in fy 25 it grew to $271,100.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Keystone rates were raised almost 11%; last year a 14% increase was reportedly absorbed through circuit breaker carryover.
budget_items.quote: the rates being raised almost 11%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Circuit breaker reimbursement has been at 75% for the last 3 to 4 years.
budget_items.quote: the last 3 to 4 years the reimbursement has been at 75%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An elevator repair was estimated and an inspection failed; repair cost was stated.
budget_items.quote: someone came in and assessed the situation and it cost $14,800 to repair.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A quote for two technicians for an eight-hour day to begin going through buildings was received.
budget_items.quote: eric hevy received a quote for having 2 technicians for an eight-hour day to start going through the building would cost roughly $3,200.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Federal grant allocations are not known until late July or early August; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: we don't find out our grant allocation for federal grants until late july or early august.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: If an article does not pass, the decision falls back to the budget, potentially paid from ARPA funds; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: potentially paying out of arpa funds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The SAP comp class impact on this year and next year’s budget would come from the salary reserve account; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the town manager confirms that is the case and that impact would come out of our salary reserve account.
